models.name: movie_platform__list_users
models.description: Each record represents a list user

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: The unique identifier of the user

columns.name: user_avatar_image_url
columns.description: User profile image URL on Mubi

columns.name: user_cover_image_url
columns.description: User profile cover image URL on Mubi

columns.name: latest_rated_movie
columns.description: The latest movie the user rated, with ties broken by the ascending order of the movie title

columns.name: list_title_most_followers
columns.description: The title of the list with the most followers created by the user, with ties broken by the ascending order of the list title

columns.name: description_list_most_followers
columns.description: The description of the list with the most followers created by the user, with ties broken by the descending order of the list description

columns.name: first_list_created
columns.description: The title of the first list created by the user, with ties broken by the ascending order of the list title

columns.name: average_followers_of_the_lists_created
columns.description: The average number of followers of the lists created by the user

columns.name: movie_id
columns.description: The unique identifier of the movie

columns.name: movie_title
columns.description: The title of the movie

columns.name: movie_url
columns.description: URL to the movie page on Mubi

columns.name: avg_rating_score
columns.description: The average rating score of the movie

columns.name: total_critic_comments
columns.description: The total number of critic comments on the movie, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: percentage_subscribers_rated
columns.description: The percentage of ratings submitted by subscribers among all ratings on the movie.

columns.name: critic_highest_number_likes
columns.description: The critic made by the user rating the movie that received the highest number of likes, with ties broken by the ascending order of the critic. Exclude NULL values.

columns.name: percentage_highest_rating_score
columns.description: The percentage of the movie's ratings that equal the highest rating score, where 'the highest rating score' is the maximum rating score across all movies

columns.name: director_id
columns.description: The unique identifier of the director

columns.name: director_url
columns.description: URL to the director page on Mubi

columns.name: director_name
columns.description: The name of the director

columns.name: third_movie_directed
columns.description: The title of the third movie directed by the director, with ties broken by the ascending order of the movie title

columns.name: highest_average_score_film
columns.description: The title of the film with the highest average score directed by the director, with ties broken by the ascending order of the film id

columns.name: number_of_movies_directed_in_70s
columns.description: The number of movies directed by the director in the 1970s, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_more_than_10_movies_1960_1985
columns.description: Set to 1 if the director has directed more than 10 movies between 1960 and 1985, 0 otherwise

columns.name: average_rating_score_of_most_popular_movie
columns.description: The average rating score of the most popular movie directed by the director, if there are multiple movies with the same popularity, rank them by the descending order of the movie id and take the first one
